# On and off by default — the `tanstack-query` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#tanstack-query).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `package.json` depends on `@tanstack/react-query` or `react-query`.
- **Rules:** 14 — 0 on, 13 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 1 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `tanstack-query/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 13 | 11 error, 2 warn | @tanstack/eslint-plugin-query 5.104.5 recommended (all 7), reimplemented, at its severities, and 6 rules from TanStack Query v5's guides (W-42) |

## Rules
